provenance.e_hbm: HYBRID: P_dyn_bnrelu_isolation (run_52610442: ~548W at R_logical=3.389 TB/s) divided by R_hbm_pmc_training (5.007e11 B/s from TCC_EA0 in native_in1k_retry_52488168 full-step PMC). Direct bnrelu isolation PMC fails on gfx942 (rocprofv3 SIGSEGV for ALL counter types on MIOpen BN kernels, confirmed jobs 52612342). Value 282 pJ/byte implies ~42% L2 hit rate in BN isolation vs full-step PMC (physically plausible: later-stage feature maps fit in 48MB L2). Cross-validation: P_hbm_pred = 282e-12 × 5.007e11 = 141W ✓ native in-sample; P_hbm_pred = 282e-12 × 6.45e11 = 182W ✓ PyTorch cross-stack.
provenance.e_comm_2node: RETRACTED bench value 9.564e-9 (was P_dyn_pergpu/algbw from pure rccl all_reduce_perf). WRONG: the 70 W/GPU bench dynamic is GPU idle-spin waiting on InfiniBand, not gradient-byte energy, and it ignores DDP compute/comm overlap. Correct method = in-situ matched compute-bound delta: e_comm_2node = (P_dyn_pergpu_2node - P_dyn_pergpu_1node) * t_step / V_ar, both runs compute-bound at identical per-GPU batch (256). PENDING a compute-bound 2-node run on the real 1.28M train set (in ImageNet-1K/imagenet-object-localization-challenge.zip). Until then nnodes>=2 falls back to intra-node e_comm=4.131e-9 (conservative; comm is <1% of total dynamic energy).

e_mfma_fp16_note: MEASURED 2026-07-07 (was proxied = e_mfma_bf16 3.426e-12). Matched-duty PyTorch probe job 53101966 (fp16_conv_energy_probe.py, RN-50 fwd+bwd, lr=0, ~100% gfx_activity, ABBA x2): at equal power (fp16 558.5 vs bf16 557.7 W) fp16 runs +7.8% faster, so the whole-network J/img is 0.929x BF16. FP16 and BF16 move IDENTICAL bytes (both 16-bit), so the ~7% saving falls entirely on the precision-dependent matrix class -> the convolution coefficient drops ~22%, not 7%, to 2.675e-12 (~2.68 pJ/FLOP). GradScaler vs no-scaler power within 0.8% -> gradient-underflow ruled out. Brings the FP16 held-out total-energy error 16.6% -> 7.7%, INSIDE the +/-10% envelope; the small residual is shared utilization-blindness.
e_gemm_bf16_note: ratio-scaled from FP32 e_gemm by the BF16/FP32 MFMA efficiency: 11.732e-12 x (3.426/9.165) = 4.386e-12 (repeat-mean basis, 2026-07-06). The FC GEMM isolation (job 52861076) measures 8.17 pJ/FLOP but is overhead-bound (tiny 2048x1000x256 GEMM at ~1.2% of BF16 peak) and overprices the large 1x1 convs that dominate the GEMM class; the full BF16 run independently implies ~4.3 pJ/FLOP, matching the ratio-derived value.
